brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0 half-n, piece:-1,0,0 full, piece:-1,1,0 full, with lockJoints bolts.
bin:0,0,0 hex-bin-half-n-full-div3, bin:-1,0,0 hex-bin-full-div3, bin:-1,1,0 hex-bin-full-div2. They drop into their cells; the top covers are over them.
drawer:0#0,0#cut, on the cut face of the half-n base at (0,0).
handle:-1,0,0;top with insert set, sitting on the covered triangle of cells (0,0), (-1,0), (-1,1).
Small footprint of three cells with a top grab handle. Weight and carry comfort were not checked; the configurator does not model that.

finish.summary: Built a three-cell organizer: a North-half base cell at (0,0) with a drawer on its cut face and a 3-compartment bin, plus two full base cells at (-1,0) and (-1,1) holding a 3-compartment and a 2-compartment bin. Covers close the top of all three cells, a grab-handle insert set (addHandle on the covered triangle) sits on top for carrying, and caps close the open faces. Joint bolts lock the joints. check_build is clean with meshClash clear. No props were added since the brief asked for the organizer itself. Not verified: how the build feels to carry, and material strength, which the configurator does not check.

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.use: A bar standing off the flat with room for a hand behind it, for a cell or a column that gets moved by its side rather than its top.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
